hints.tr: İki listedeki bütün farklı değerler: `sorted(set(a) | set(b))`.
hints.en: All the distinct values in both lists: `sorted(set(a) | set(b))`.

hints.tr: Her `x` için `abs(bisect.bisect_right(a, x) / len(a) - bisect.bisect_right(b, x) / len(b))`; en büyüğünü `max` ile tut.
hints.en: For every `x`, `abs(bisect.bisect_right(a, x) / len(a) - bisect.bisect_right(b, x) / len(b))`; keep the largest with `max`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import bisect


def ks_statistic(a, b):
    a, b = sorted(a), sorted(b)
    largest = 0
    for x in sorted(set(a) | set(b)):
        share_a = bisect.bisect_right(a, x) / len(a)
        share_b = bisect.bisect_right(b, x) / len(b)
        largest = max(largest, abs(share_a - share_b))
    return round(largest, 3)


a = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
print(ks_statistic(a, a))
print(ks_statistic(a, [3, 4, 5, 6, 7]))
print(ks_statistic([1, 1, 2], [2, 2, 3]))
```

import bisect


def ks_statistic(a, b):
    a, b = sorted(a), sorted(b)
    largest = 0
    for x in sorted(set(a) | set(b)):
        share_a = bisect.bisect_right(a, x) / len(a)
        share_b = bisect.bisect_right(b, x) / len(b)
        largest = max(largest, abs(share_a - share_b))
    return round(largest, 3)


a = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
print(ks_statistic(a, a))
print(ks_statistic(a, [3, 4, 5, 6, 7]))
